note: Example data: an invented heating, cooling and plumbing company with an invented Google Ads account, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The example's competitors are invented and lettered A to C. The message_test block is a second invented run of the same business for Mode 2: its survey answers are generated, and every count, rate, interval and verdict in expected_output.json message_test is computed from them.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "usp-extractor" skill. Find our USP: what can we say that the companies around us can't, and that people actually respond to?
business: Example Home Services, a heating, cooling and plumbing company (invented example)
focus: AC repair: the service line with the most non-brand conversions
market_search: 'ac repair' searched from Riverton, the largest town, desktop, top 20 results
competitors: not given, so the first 3 companies in that search (directories and matching services left out)
data_pulled: ad_group_ad_asset_view: 18 distinct headline and description lines in non-brand campaigns
campaign totals (visible share and segment conversion rates)
onpage_content_parsing: your AC-repair page and 3 competitor pages; your home page came back empty twice
not_connected: Google Business Profile for this company (customer voice comes from the testimonials on its own page)
Search Console for this company (buyer words come from search terms only)

ad_lines.line: Rated 4.9 stars on 1,200+ reviews. See why your neighbors call us first.
Same-day AC repair from licensed technicians. Upfront prices before any work starts.
Call or book online. Evening and weekend slots, no overtime charges, 90-day guarantee.
Our technicians give honest advice and never push a replacement you don't need.
Free estimate on any new system, and financing on approved credit.
Licensed, insured technicians with 25 years of experience in local homes.

search_terms.term: how much does ac repair cost
is it worth repairing an old ac

your_page_units.text: AC repair in Riverton, Lakemoor and the nearby towns, from licensed local technicians.
Rated 4.9 stars on 1,200+ reviews from homeowners across Riverton.
We tell you the price before any work starts, and the price we agree is the price you pay.
Every repair comes with a 90-day guarantee on parts and labour.
We repair before we replace. If a new system makes more sense, we explain why and give you a free second opinion.
Same-day appointments on most days, evenings and weekends included.
Licensed, insured technicians with 25 years of experience.
Free estimate on any new system.
Book online in 60 seconds or call (555) 010-0199.
How an AC works: the compressor moves refrigerant between the coils.
your_page_units.kind: general information, not a claim about the business

testimonials: They fixed it the same day and the price was exactly what they quoted.
Honest advice: they repaired our old unit instead of selling us a new one.
On time, polite, and the price was agreed before they started.
They told us a repair would do for now and never pushed a replacement.

Competitor A: Free estimates on all new systems.
The best technicians in the area.
Competitor B: Same-day AC repair from a local technician.
Competitor C: Fast, honest AC repair for local homes.
Call today for a free quote.

message_test.request: Hey Claude, I just added the "usp-extractor" skill. Before we rewrite the AC page, test the USP and the two alternatives against our current lead line, and tell me which one to use.

messages.source: primary USP from the Mode 1 run

message_test.question: clarity and appeal: does each line get understood, and which makes a homeowner most likely to book
message_test.buyer: homeowners in the service area with central AC
message_test.decision: the line that leads the AC page hero and the AC Repair ads

klaviyo_segment.name: Quote requests, not booked, last 12 months

google_ads_ad_group_last_28_days.ad_group: AC Repair (the focus line's ad group with the most clicks)

message_test.survey_window: 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-28 (sent by the business from its own email tool)
